segments.description: Takes deposits from the public and invests them mainly in residential, multifamily and commercial real estate loans.
segments.evidence: Our business consists primarily of taking deposits from the general public and investing those deposits, together with funds generated from operations, in one-to-four family residential real estate loans, commercial real estate and multifamily real estate loans, construction and land loans and home equity lines of credit and loans.
